name: nesting
what: three shapes kept apart: containers in a guest, a vm in a guest, a container as the guest
install: git clone -b nesting https://github.com/tinkrland/spawnables.git && cd spawnables && PYTHONPATH=. ./bin/nesting probe
verify_expect: a facts block: cpu_virt, kvm, nested, runtimes

refused: a vm inside a guest without vmx/svm, /dev/kvm and nested=1 together
reading nested=1 as proof: a guest can report it with no hardware behind it
